events.name: DISABLED
events.text: You have a terrible accident which almost cripples you. Your Movement Allowance values should always be read from the line above the normal in the Combat Statistics Table. An operation to fix you would cost about 100,000 crowns.

events.name: BONE DISEASE
events.text: Subtract 3 from your maximum HP. An operation to fix you would cost about 50,000 crowns.

events.name: SEVERE CONCUSSION
events.text: You never quite healed from that last blow to your head. Your Defensive and Perception Bonuses should always be read one line above the normal in the Combat Statistics Table.

events.name: INVOLVED IN SERIOUS CRIME
events.text: Guilty or not, you've been sentenced to 1d6+3 years of hard labor (adjust your age). +1 STR and CON, −1 INT and WIS, criminal record.

events.name: INVOLVED IN MINOR CRIME
events.text: You get involved in petty organized crime and are sentenced to 1d3 years of prison (adjust your age). −1 STR and WIS, +1 CHA, criminal record.

events.name: GUILTY
events.text: A judge forced you to refund your neighbors for a case against you. Reduce your Credit Score by 5.

events.name: CRIMINAL RECORD
events.text: Your name is mentioned in connection with a criminal act, and you are recorded in criminal records, probably for life. −5 Credit Score, and your career phase is over: you hit the streets now.

events.name: FIRED
events.text: Intrigue or mistakes cost you your job: the next two years are spent unemployed (a Drifter / Outcast term follows at once, no roll).

events.name: INTENSE EDUCATION
events.text: A stretch of rigorous study: sharper mind, fewer friends. +1 INT, −1 CHA.

events.name: PART OF UNEMPLOYMENT PROGRAM
events.text: Once: if an entry roll fails, the program sends you to study instead of the street — you serve that term as the Student career that fits what you tried (Technical University otherwise).

events.name: GOOD NEGOTIATOR
events.text: You excel at managing social friction. +1 CHA.

events.name: GLAMOROUS EMPLOYMENT
events.text: Your presence opens doors in corporate circles. Add +1 to CHA.

events.name: CONTACT WITHIN A MEGACORP
events.text: You have a contact within one of the megacorporations. Work with your GM to decide how this contact provides insider info or favors. The first favor: your next entry roll is waived.

events.name: CIVIL DEFENSE TRAINING
events.text: You have basic civilian defense discipline and weapons handling under stress. Add +1 to DEX.

events.name: TECHNICAL CRASH COURSE
events.text: Intensive technical training in electronics and systems repair, at a desk. +1 INT, −1 STR.

events.name: ADMINISTRATION NIGHT CLASSES
events.text: Evening coursework after a full day of work: procedure and negotiation, and no sleep. +1 INT, −1 CON.

events.name: GYMNASTICS CLASSES
events.text: Physical conditioning improves your poise, agility, and mobility. Add +1 to DEX.

events.name: EVENING CLASSES
events.text: Broad adult education sharpens your intellect; your evenings out are over. +1 INT, −1 CHA.

events.name: INTERESTING CHARACTER
events.text: You always seem to fascinate people. Add +1 to CHA.

events.name: HARD LABOR
events.text: Manual labor toughens your body and leaves no room for anything else. +1 STR, −1 INT.

events.name: STRONG WILL
events.text: Emotional turmoil hardened your outlook, and it shows. +1 MST, −1 CHA.

events.name: HEALTH CARE
events.text: Eating well and taking care of your body pays off; healthy food isn't cheap. +1 CON, −1 Credit Score.

events.name: AMATEUR GYMNAST
events.text: Lean and quick, not strong. +1 DEX, −1 STR.

events.name: GOOD IMMUNE SYSTEM
events.text: Your body is extremely resistant to alien organic substances. Add +1 to CON.

events.name: EXTRAORDINARY CHEMICAL TOLERANCE
events.text: Your body shrugs off toxins and gases; you found out by trying a lot of things. +1 CON, −1 WIS.

events.name: GIFTED CHILDHOOD
events.text: Early exposure to many disciplines pays off. +1 to INT or WIS.

events.name: WEALTHY LOVER
events.text: Your lover is very wealthy and quite generous. It's complicated. +3 Credit Score, −1 MST.

events.name: STEADY EMPLOYMENT
events.text: Steady, reliable work. +2 Credit Score, and your next entry roll in this career is waived.

events.name: AMATEUR ATHLETE
events.text: Regular training at a gym keeps you fit; the membership is not free. +1 CON, −1 Credit Score.

events.name: CHANCE OF A LIFETIME
events.text: You may choose any background, regardless of its requirements and spend 2 years in any profession you like.

events.name: CONTACTS WITHIN POLICE DEPARTMENT
events.text: You will never, ever get your name on a criminal record. If you've been recorded as a criminal, your record is expunged.

events.name: SOLE HEIR TO WEALTHY AUNT
events.text: Your extremely rich aunt remembered you in her will. Add +3 to Credit Score (100 is maximum).

events.name: POWERFUL, FANATIC ENEMY
events.text: You have made a deadly enemy who is also quite powerful: a district attorney, an old flame with corporate friends, a cult leader. Work it out with your GM. Living looking over your shoulder: +1 MST.

events.name: LONG LEGS
events.text: Your Movement Allowance values should always be read from the line below the normal in the Combat Statistics Table.

events.name: FAMOUS FACE
events.text: You look a lot like a very famous person. Everyone stares. +2 CHA, −1 MST.

events.name: MOVIE STAR
events.text: You've had a couple of small parts in soap operas and B-movies. +1 CHA, +2 Credit Score.

events.name: PROMOTION
events.text: Promoted. +3 Credit Score, and your next entry roll in this career is waived.

events.name: SUBJECT TO EXPERIMENTS
events.text: You volunteer for a secret medical experiment, and it works. Mostly. +2 WIS, −1 CON.

events.name: COMMANDO TRAINING
events.text: Four years of elite commando training instead of two: +1 STR, DEX and MST, +2 Credit Score, the Military Academy credential, and 2 extra years of age.
